method: Visually read every listed source PNG (PDF page index printed-page+1); read every printed theorem proof, key task, worked example and associated figure in §§10–19. OCR was a locator, not mathematical authority.

Independently read all27 detail cards and10 overviews in full, including prompts containing hypotheses, optional hints, model points, edges, faces and step-to-view mappings. Checked all95 inventory entries against the source and mapped content.

Checked general proof logic separately from numerical illustrations: arbitrary n-gons, existence/uniqueness arguments, inside/outside projection, nondegeneracy, equality cases and endpoint angles. A numerical model alone was never treated as a proof.

Wrote a separate reviewer program using standard-library vector operations without importing any author module. Verified all37 actual models plus deterministic general families of projection, common perpendiculars, affine parallelepipeds, regular pyramids and frustums.

Overviews were reviewed as the compact introduction in combination with their explicit detail cards; no claim that every detail proof is duplicated in an overview. Source, mathematics and pedagogy were independently rechecked for every one of these10 overview cards.
